abstract: Evaluates airframe endurance thresholds and operational safety radii
system_message:
You are the Fleet airworthiness engineer (ENG), responsible for evaluating airframe endurance thresholds, operational safety radii, and auxiliary power unit serviceability for aeromedical evacuation corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evaluates airframe endurance thresholds and operational safety radii（RAD）
information_points.content:
ENG-RAD-A1L：For the Nahanni Canyon Low-Level Vector corridor, airframe performance evaluations in a dedicated medical evacuation twin-turboprop configuration establish a safe operational radius of 560 km while maintaining the mandatory 45-minute VFR fuel reserve.
ENG-RAD-MG3：For the Liard Basin High-Altitude Direct corridor, airframe performance evaluations in a dedicated medical evacuation twin-turboprop configuration establish a safe operational radius of 480 km while maintaining the mandatory 45-minute VFR fuel reserve.
ENG-RAD-ZZ9：For the Fort Simpson Ridge Transit corridor, airframe performance evaluations in a dedicated medical evacuation twin-turboprop configuration establish a safe operational radius of 480 km while maintaining the mandatory 45-minute VFR fuel reserve.

information_points.title: Auxiliary power serviceability（APU）
information_points.content:
ENG-APU-B6Q：Standby turbine auxiliary power unit testing for the Liard Basin High-Altitude Direct corridor demonstrates an auxiliary power unit starting reliability of 96% across cold-soak activation trials.
ENG-APU-CL0：Standby turbine auxiliary power unit testing for the Fort Simpson Ridge Transit corridor demonstrates an auxiliary power unit starting reliability of 98% across cold-soak activation trials.
ENG-APU-CP5：Standby turbine auxiliary power unit testing for the Nahanni Canyon Low-Level Vector corridor demonstrates an auxiliary power unit starting reliability of 100% across cold-soak activation trials.
